heading: Alpha test — bounded per test
text:
### Alpha test — bounded per test [LNLS.5.2]

Every alpha test in a `linear_scan: false` program is a scalar comparison
(int, float, bool), an interned-string pointer comparison, or an ordering or
regex test on a `String` slot that declares `capacity N` ([LNLS.3.10]), whose
cost [LNLS.5.7] bounds by N. N is a compile-time constant, so each test is
bounded by a constant.

The total alpha test cost per fact assert is O(T) where T is the
number of tests per alpha node — a compile-time constant.
